T

TrinoDataStore - Class in org.locationtech.geomesa.trino.datastore
Read-only GeoTools ContentDataStore backed by a Trino/Iceberg catalog, with Z2/XZ2 partition pruning and row-level visibility.
TrinoDataStoreFactory - Class in org.locationtech.geomesa.trino.datastore
GeoTools DataStoreFactorySpi that creates read-only TrinoDataStores backed by Trino/Iceberg, discovered via the GeoTools DataStoreFinder service loader.
TrinoDataStoreFactory() - Constructor for class org.locationtech.geomesa.trino.datastore.TrinoDataStoreFactory
Default constructor; instances are created by the GeoTools DataStoreFinder SPI.
TrinoFilterToSQL - Class in org.locationtech.geomesa.trino.datastore
Translates GeoTools filters to Trino SQL WHERE clauses of pure row-level ST_* function calls (plus temporal/attribute predicates).
TrinoFilterToSQL() - Constructor for class org.locationtech.geomesa.trino.datastore.TrinoFilterToSQL
Creates a filter translator that double-quotes identifiers.

USER - Static variable in class org.locationtech.geomesa.trino.datastore.TrinoDataStoreFactory

W

writeLiteral(Object) - Method in class org.locationtech.geomesa.trino.datastore.TrinoFilterToSQL
Temporal literals must be TIMESTAMP-typed in the emitted SQL: the base class writes Date values as quoted strings, which Trino cannot compare to a timestamp-with-time-zone column.
